title: bankstatementparser /api/v1/parse response (v1)
description: The source. Karr keeps a copy under tests/contract/bankstatementparser/ and a test on each side reads the same sample-v1-scan.json, so whichever side drifts goes red. /api/v1 only grows: a breaking change is /api/v2.

parser_version.description: also the X-Parser-Version header on every /api/v1 answer

account_info.description: pre-v1 shape: account_number, ifsc, opening_balance, closing_balance, holder, branch

opening_balance.description: as printed; null when the statement prints none

period.description: pre-v1: the period as a sentence ('01/04/2025 to 30/04/2025') or 'N/A'

period_from.description: the period PRINTED on the statement, YYYY-MM-DD; null when it prints none

filled.description: figures the parser made up: balances computed from the one before, amounts inferred from the balance movement

seq.description: 1-based, in the order the parser answers

date.description: DD-MM-YYYY as the bank prints it

balance_source.description: present when the statement printed no balance here and the parser computed it; a reader never counts such a balance as evidence

amount_source.description: present when the parser took the amount from the balance movement
